metadata.name: get_member_savings_balance
metadata.discovery_goal: Look up member 12345 and read their current savings balance
metadata.author: llm-discovery-agent

inputs.name: member_id
inputs.description: The unique identifier of the member to look up

outputs.name: savings_balance
outputs.description: The current savings balance of the specified member

preconditions: Operator session must be authenticated (see login capability / precondition).

fallbacks.description: by structural css fallback for 'Member ID'

target.robustness_note: Primary keys on accessibility role+accessible-name, which survives layout/styling changes. Fallbacks degrade through element id, then visible text, then structural CSS position -- chosen so a change on one axis (e.g. relabeling) doesn't break all locators at once.

declared_outcomes.name: MEMBER_NOT_FOUND
declared_outcomes.description: The supplied member ID does not exist in the system.

declared_outcomes.name: VALIDATION_ERROR
declared_outcomes.description: One or more supplied input values failed server-side validation.

declared_outcomes.name: PERMISSION_DENIED
declared_outcomes.description: The target member/account is restricted (e.g. frozen) and the action is not permitted.

declared_outcomes.name: SESSION_TIMEOUT
declared_outcomes.description: The operator session expired mid-flow; replay should re-authenticate and retry once.

declared_outcomes.name: SYSTEM_BUSY
declared_outcomes.description: A transient backend timeout; replay should retry with backoff before failing hard.
